args.reason: The DoD covers one capability: inspecting the current merge-ok/blocked decision without merging, with a test double asserting that no merge call is made under --dry-run. That is exactly the first PRD goal. It reuses the existing floor reads, so the merge-floor logic stays the single source of truth (second goal). No history, storage or query capability is added, so nothing in the DoD exceeds the declared goals.
